steps.en: Install into an isolated ~/.octop venv (one-liner or PyPI)
steps.zh: 装进隔离的 ~/.octop 虚拟环境（一键脚本或 PyPI）

steps.en: Bootstrap the admin account, JWT secret and SQLite file
steps.zh: 初始化管理员账号、JWT 密钥和 SQLite 库

steps.en: Serves dashboard, CLI, IM and cron on one port; rebuilds from SQLite
steps.zh: 同一端口提供控制台、IM 和 cron，重启从 SQLite 重建

steps.en: Create an agent, attach a model, connect Feishu or WeCom
steps.zh: 建一个 Agent，接上模型，再挂飞书或企微

steps.en: Routes Web, IM and cron through one in-process processor
steps.zh: 把 Web、IM、cron 送进同一条处理管线

value.en: A household or small team shares local agents on the IM they already use, without standing up a queue or a second service
value.zh: 家里或小团队能在已有的 IM 上共用本机 Agent，不用另起队列或第二个服务

sources: https://github.com/TencentCloud/Octop/blob/main/README.md Quick Start (pip install octop, octop init, octop run, ~/.octop/, Feishu/WeCom channels)
https://github.com/TencentCloud/Octop/blob/main/docs/architecture.md (single process, WebSocket/IM/cron share the agent runtime, SQLite/PostgreSQL control plane)
https://github.com/TencentCloud/Octop/blob/main/docs/adr/001-single-process-model.md (no Redis, no worker, no external queue)
https://github.com/TencentCloud/Octop/blob/main/pyproject.toml (project.scripts octop = octop.cli.main:cli; orcakit-harness-agent / harness-gateway / harness-memory / harness-browser)
